text:
## Creative brief
Plan a ~60-second documentary about how Viviana turned her pottery into Mud Witch and why she values pottery.

## Overview & Tone

This 60-second profile is structured as an intimate, rhythmic journey tracing Viviana’s identity, aesthetic philosophy, and tactile connection to pottery. We begin with the whimsical energy of her finished brand, pull back into the physical studio space to explore the body-positive origins of her silhouettes, and finish on an evocative, tactile exploration of why handmade objects matter in a disconnected world. The pacing moves smoothly from bright and dynamic to grounded and meditative, matching her craft.

---

## Story Beats

#### 1. The Artist and the Studio (0:00–0:15) [node: beat_930acbdf-f2d1-449c-8bcd-bb11d578c3ad]

We open directly on a snappy visual montage of finished pieces [node: card_318dcaab-d065-421b-a5f9-f972dc905e52] [node: card_f3e51bee-9706-4cff-af2a-93ac329c952f], cutting across the pastel display selections [node: card_f6c0735c-3c63-4861-b5d5-29b0a8075103] (B003C050_240719XK (19.5s–27s); B003C050_240719XK (7.5s–19.5s); B003C050_240719XK (0s–7.5s))—sundae ceramics, watermelon containers, and checkered display boxes—to immediately establish the playful visual world of Mud Witch. The tone here is welcoming, vibrant, and grounded [node: card_b733a200-35f0-4cf3-b245-49f1a043a039]. 

Under these opening visuals, we bring in Viviana’s voiceover introduction [node: card_f723ceed-7af2-4394-bb18-1e2423282287] (A001C002_240718OR (48s–54.2s); A001C002_240718OR (14s–25s)) where she introduces her background and reflects on the reality of being a full-time artist as hard work yet a dream come true [node: card_72941b8c-aca2-4c7a-b463-bb6420664c51]. As her voice settles in, we cut to exterior B-roll of Viviana entering the studio from the sidewalk [node: card_1bf64e73-2ca8-45e8-b68a-e786b4a32fc5] (B003C061_240719AN (19.1s–24.8s)) [node: card_6f178bba-3566-4c55-a7c9-861c3d8d4ce1], seamlessly transitioning the audience into her working environment. We button this opening beat with a tight insert shot of the branded Mud Witch sign resting on the studio shelf [node: card_1ba18abc-dd27-476f-8067-a3bdba502015] (B003C010_240719TX (0s–5.1s)) [node: card_b895eacc-f038-44ab-9315-4aaabf341840], trimmed tightly to anchor her brand before diving into the core creative philosophy.

#### 2. Mud Witch Style & Body Positivity (0:15–0:38) [node: beat_b279b409-c73d-4a3e-8d53-562b3b1a2ef2]

We cut on-camera to Viviana [node: card_f211af40-5744-4b7e-8789-54e88137ae55] as she articulates the spark behind her signature style: discovering the body positivity movement while learning clay [node: card_334028d6-b665-44cf-b49c-b22848c8e463] (A001C004_240718BC (668.9s–682.5s); A001C004_240718BC (693.9s–702.1s)) [node: card_3c9084c0-6f9a-4551-9a9f-29779cb186a3]. The tone shifts into an inspiring, creative reflection on form and inclusivity [node: card_3f017356-406f-434f-9f68-e77c35b94db9].

As she details the creation of the Chubby and Venus silhouettes [node: card_74997b56-0890-4f7d-b8a2-e74ec5189444], her dialogue rolls into voiceover while the visuals cut away to active process footage from the B-roll bank [node: card_7f85eedb-8304-4396-92a7-e4d4f60b5581] (B003C011_240719YX (21.3s–37.9s); B003C028_240719CX (5.8s–11.2s)). We show her shaping clay at the wheel [node: card_9902d696-b736-4d66-a7fd-09d3b76e27fa], rhythmically juxtaposed against rows of unpainted, raw ceramic vessels waiting on the drying shelves [node: card_d975044d-27f9-46e2-a2fc-c64d6daf8d4b]. This dynamic balance between raw inventory and wet shaping keeps the pace brisk while visually underlining how her concepts translate directly into physical curves.

#### 3. The Artist's Hand and Human Connection (0:38–1:00) [node: beat_cedff104-a47f-4e2d-aa42-9daaf74724ee]

The final movement deepens into a reflective, tactile close [node: card_86733a19-14ec-4544-b499-e7001d6ca991]. We lead with Viviana’s voiceover explaining the concept of the "artist's hand" and the grounding power of touch [node: card_6bc3a3b1-7235-44fd-9e99-1fe1d7a5c970] (A001C004_240718BC (897.6s–906.3s)) [node: card_42463295-38de-4cbd-8252-84e9e1375a8d], ensuring tight audio micro-edits to eliminate pauses and ums for a crisp cadence [node: card_82ebda29-aa03-4404-bb0b-abb2df4c88aa].

Visuals explore the emotional intimacy of the craft [node: card_32c684e5-e54f-45f1-9f7d-4954ff7e19ba], utilizing the production B-roll group [node: card_58ec5f5c-bcb7-4ed7-9bd3-0c7217016d94] (B003C006_240719KM (136.4s–145.1s); B003C005_240719NB (0.8s–13.5s)) by cutting between a delicate shot of her hand-painting a ceramic bowl [node: card_304fec7f-c493-4eca-9d32-63e2e196b230] and an intimate medium shot of her inspecting pieces on the shelves [node: card_ed7bbd6c-d0cc-4121-a193-df888381ac27]. For the climax, we carry Viviana’s concluding thoughts on the necessity of human interaction and physical craft in an increasingly digital world [node: card_4f4aca71-356a-4d79-9038-225264a88c6b] (A001C004_240718BC (907.1s–923.6s)) [node: card_4ccb6b07-6233-46b8-9e74-1ce5efff621a] over a focused, evocative shot of her hands guiding clay on the spinning wheel [node: card_56541ecc-1d07-4ee2-addf-c2fc665e65bc] (B003C011_240719YX (68.3s–84.3s)) [node: card_e515b4c0-aa5a-4281-a22f-a9f0a36cb789], letting the motion and her final words linger together into the fade out.

## Constraints

- The plan above is the spec — it already made the editorial calls (what to use, what to omit, how to sequence and combine material). Follow the plan's own decisions rather than independently re-deriving them from first principles.
- Track is authoritative for whatever the plan places on a given track. A shot the plan describes as A-Roll must land on the A-Roll track, B-Roll on B-Roll, music on the Music track, and text/graphics on the Text/Graphics track. A card does not count as fulfilled merely because related material appears elsewhere in the timeline on the wrong track.
- Timecodes and durations in the plan are approximate targets, not exact requirements — use editorial judgment on the actual cut points, same as any real edit.
- A Music card whose source names a real file path (marked "real stock audio file") must be added directly with `edit-timeline add-clip <path> --row music --role music` — do not call `/generate music` for it.

## Instructions for tagging

When adding a clip with `edit-timeline add-clip`, attach the corresponding plan node ID using `--node-ids card_<id>` (or `beat_<id>` for a beat-level marker).

If one clip fulfills multiple plan node ids, include all applicable ones.

Only attach a node ID when the clip actually fulfills what the plan describes for it, including its named track. Use the exact node IDs from the plan. Do not invent or modify them.

## Completion requirements

Before finishing, verify against the plan's own decisions, not the original grid.

For each beat, confirm the edit the plan describes was actually realized: the right material landed on the right track, in the intended order, with any transitions/overlaps the plan called out.

For any node id the plan itself named as an intentionally unused alternative or backup, no further action is needed — that was already the plan's own decision, not something to silently reconsider or silently include anyway.

A node id that the plan actively describes using, but that never lands on the corresponding clip, is a real gap — note it and the reason in verification.
